\om shrI→ॐ శ్రీ
ॐ  is  \om — plain om/OM/AUM stay as letters (so komala → కొమల, not కॐఅల). Typing English? Every Latin letter maps to Telugu — switch layouts for Latin text.
Case-sensitive · t త vs T ట · s స vs S శ. Telugu rendering uses your system font. teltools Telugu (ITRANS) · matches trans()
